name: Test medium code
description: Code specifying the medium on which a test was or is to be applied.

values.name: Animal
values.description: Animal Specifies the medium being tested is an animal.

values.name: Human
values.description: Human Specifies the medium being tested is a human.

values.name: Sulphide
values.description: Sulphide Specifies that the medium being tested is the sulphide component.

values.name: Aluminate
values.description: Aluminate Specifies that the medium being tested is the aluminate component.

values.name: Silicate
values.description: Silicate Specifies that the medium being tested is the silicate component.

values.name: Oxide
values.description: Oxide Specifies that the medium being tested is the oxide component.

values.name: Mutually defined
values.description: Mutually defined A code assigned within a code list whose meaning is agreed among partners to be used on an interim basis until a precise code can be assigned to the code list.
